methodologyNotes: Covers 13 compound (compound-optical, eyepiece+objective-turret) microscopes a 2026 buyer actually cross-shops: budget-to-mid student/hobbyist trinoculars with integrated USB cameras (AmScope T490B-5MT, AmScope B120C-M, Swift SW380T, OMAX M837ZL, Levenhuk D740T), entry monocular lab scopes (Celestron LABS CM2000CF, Bresser Erudit DLX), a legacy university digital-camera scope (National Optical DC5-163), and clinical/educational-grade instruments from the major optics brands (Evident/Olympus CX23, Nikon Eclipse E100, Leica DM750, Zeiss Primostar 3, Motic BA210). One seed from the original brief, the Andonstar AD409, was dropped after verification: it is a single-lens handheld/HDMI digital inspection scope (no eyepiece, objective turret, or condenser) and does not fit the 'compound microscope' schema (head_type, objective_count, condenser_type, mechanical_stage would all be fabricated); it was replaced with AmScope B120C-M, Nikon Eclipse E100, Leica DM750, and Zeiss Primostar 3 to keep the roster at a genuine apples-to-apples compound-microscope comparison spanning ~$300-$3,000+. max_magnification is the manufacturer-stated total magnification (highest objective x eyepiece, using the eyepiece pairing the source itself uses for its headline 'NNx-NNNNx' figure, e.g. a 100x oil objective x a 25x eyepiece for machines marketed with a 25x eyepiece option) - not a sum. objective_count is the number of nosepiece positions on the standard/base configuration described. camera_compatible is true if the product ships with an integrated digital camera, a trinocular/photo port, or a documented C-mount/eyepiece-camera adapter path; false only where a source explicitly rules this out; null where genuinely undocumented. Every product's optical/mechanical specs were independently fetched from either the manufacturer's own product or spec page (Evident/Olympus, Nikon, Leica, Zeiss, Bresser, Levenhuk, National Optical's own PDF datasheet) or, where the manufacturer's storefront returned persistent HTTP 429 bot-blocking on every attempt across many retries and IP-varying reseller domains (amscope.com, swiftmicroscopes.com, omaxmicroscope.com, celestron.com, motic.com, nationaloptical.com all did this consistently), from a named US reseller's product page instead (amscope.shop, selectumllc.com, kwtelescope.com, camnexas.com, motic-microscope.com, review-rating.com, microscopecrew.com) - every such substitution is flagged in that product's provenance. priceUsd is the clearest confirmed US-dollar starting price found; several products in this category (Evident CX23, National Optical DC5-163, Bresser Erudit DLX, Levenhuk D740T, OMAX M837ZL base config, Leica DM750, Zeiss Primostar 3) are sold through quote-only/B2B lab-equipment channels or EU-only storefronts with no public US list price, and priceUsd is null for these rather than converting a foreign-currency figure or borrowing a different SKU's price - the specific figures that were found (EUR prices, sibling-model prices, higher-spec-variant prices) are preserved in priceNote for context. Images: a manufacturer-hosted or manufacturer-supplied reseller product photo, HTTP-verified and visually inspected (via direct file fetch) at capture time for each; four products (AmScope T490B-5MT, Swift SW380T, National Optical DC5-163, OMAX M837ZL) had no independently fetchable direct image file found despite repeated attempts (dead links, JS-rendered galleries, or only a text-and-stock-photo review-blog banner) and ship without an image key rather than a guessed or mismatched one. No Wikimedia Commons images were usable: Commons has no photos of these specific SKUs, and the closest hits (a different-generation Nikon Eclipse Ci, an older two-word 'Primo Star' Zeiss unit) were rejected as not depicting the exact product. accessedAt 2026-08-01 throughout.

products.priceNote: swiftmicroscopes.com (manufacturer) returned persistent HTTP 429 across more than five separate attempts over the session; no independently confirmed US-dollar price was found. An EU reseller (albenth.com) listed roughly EUR 374, which is not used here since it is not a US figure.

specs.focus_mechanism: Dual coarse and ultra-fine focus controls

products.provenance: swiftmicroscopes.com returned HTTP 429 on every attempt (manufacturer domain plus a reseller mirror, albenth.com, both persistently blocked). Specs corroborated across two independent reviewer/retailer sources: microscopecrew.com states 4x/10x/40x/100x-oil DIN achromatic objectives, interchangeable WF10x/25x eyepieces, ABBE condenser, LED illumination, and camera-ready eyepiece tube; review-rating.com independently confirms the Siedentopf 360-degree trinocular head, four-objective DIN turret, LED illumination, and dual coarse/ultra-fine focus. One reviewer snippet listed a '25x objective' which is almost certainly a transcription mix-up with the 25x eyepiece option (25x objectives are not a standard DIN size and the stated 40x-2500x range only reconciles with a standard 4/10/40/100x objective set paired with 10x/25x eyepieces); the standard 4/10/40/100x set is used here. A 5MP or 25MP Swiftcam is available but sold as an add-on per the Amazon listing title, not confirmed integrated by default.

Full spec sheet fetched from kwtelescope.com (an authorized Celestron reseller): 40x-2000x range (8 discrete magnification levels: 40/80/100/200/400/800/1000/2000x), monocular 360-degree/45-degree head, 4x/10x/40x/100x-oil achromatic objectives, one 10x and one 20x eyepiece, 110x125mm mechanical stage, 1.25 NA Abbe condenser with iris, halogen illumination, rack-and-pinion coarse/fine focus. products.provenance: Fetched directly from evidentscientific.com (olympus-lifescience.com now 301-redirects here, confirming this is the current official home of the Olympus microscope line). Page states binocular and trinocular tube options at 30 degrees, LED transmitted illumination, manual right-hand-control mechanical stage (X 76mm / Y 30mm travel), Abbe condenser N.A. 1.25, stage-focus system with 15mm coarse stroke, and trinocular-tube compatibility with the EP50 wireless digital camera. Standard quad-nosepiece objective set (4x/10x/40x/100x oil) and 10x eyepiece give a 1000x optical maximum for the base configuration; no price is published anywhere in the fetched content.

products.name: National Optical DC5-163

specs.head_type: Binocular, 30-degree inclined, dual diopter, with 3-position beam-splitter (100% binocular / 100% camera / 70:30 split)
specs.condenser_type: Abbe, N.A. 1.25, iris diaphragm, rack-and-pinion focus, swing-out filter holder (clear/blue/green/yellow)

products.provenance: nationaloptical.com returned HTTP 429 on every attempt across multiple URL guesses. Full official National Optical spec/instruction sheet (model DC5-163 & DC5-163-P) was instead retrieved as a PDF hosted by homesciencetools.com and read directly: widefield 10x/18mm eyepiece (pointer standard), 30-degree inclined binoculars with 54-76mm interpupillary adjustment, DIN 4x(0.10)/10x(0.25)/40xR(0.65)/100xR-oil(1.25) achromatic or plan objectives on a ball-bearing quad turret, built-in 2.0-megapixel USB 2.0 digital camera (1600x1200, USB-powered) working alongside a fully independent optical path, 140x135mm mechanical stage (70x50mm travel, 0.1mm graduation), 1.25 NA Abbe condenser, 12V/20W halogen illumination on a 100-240V universal supply, and coaxial coarse/fine focus. No price was present in this datasheet and none could be found elsewhere; this appears to be an older, still-cataloged SKU sold mainly to institutional buyers rather than direct consumers.

SKU 5102000: 4x/10x/40x/100x-oil achromatic DIN objectives, monocular 360-degree rotatable tube, LED illumination with dimmer, Abbe condenser with adjustable height and filter holder, coaxial mechanical stage with vernier ('nonius'), coaxial coarse/fine focus. products.name: OMAX M837ZL

Confirmed USD prices exist only for higher-spec darkfield/phase-contrast M837ZL family variants: $1,719.00 (M837ZL-A191BOIL-TP, primelabmed.com) and $1,772.99 (M837ZL-PHB1-A185A-C50U3). products.provenance: omaxmicroscope.com returned HTTP 429 on every direct attempt (including the M837ZL-TP and M837ZL-PHB1-A185A-C50U3 product URLs); curativescope.com and primelabmed.com direct fetches were also blocked (403/404). Specs given here are drawn from consistently repeated figures across independently indexed retailer/manufacturer copy (40x-2500x range, 10x/25x eyepieces, 4x/10x/40x/100x objectives, LED illumination, mechanical stage, 5-10MP USB camera options, Abbe N.A.1.25 condenser with iris) rather than a single directly-rendered fetch; focus mechanism specifics were not found in any reachable source and are left null rather than assumed to match sibling AmScope-family products. No image file could be independently fetched (manufacturer galleries are JS-rendered; reseller pages 403'd).
